name: Daily Fantasy Storybook Video Pipeline (Gentle Soul)
description: Generates a 1080p 30fps Moving Storybook (【動く旅の絵本】) fantasy ambient music video using the fixed pipeline at /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/src/storybook_pipeline.py (Flux 1080p + watercolor.safetensors LoRA, multi-shot 2.5D motion + rain/starlight/embers/leaves + cold-press paper vignette, ACE-Step 1.5 / HeartMuLa 80% instrumental + 20% ethereal vocalise, -22 LUFS Foley ambience) and uploads it to the Gentle Soul YouTube channel.

steps.title: Generate Daily Moving Storybook Video
steps.description:
Run the fixed Gentle Soul Moving Storybook pipeline from your task's artifacts directory ($COWORK_ARTIFACTS_DIR):

python3 /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/src/storybook_pipeline.py \
  --work-dir . \
  --past-used /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/config/past_used.json \
  --engine acestep15 \
  --acts 3 --tracks-per-act 3 --song-seconds 180 \
  --shots-per-track 3 --shot-loop-seconds 6.0 \
  --foley-lufs -22.0 --export-ep

Verify that covers_contact.jpg, songs.json, full_description.txt, album_build/music/01..09.mp3, album_build/loops/01..09.mp4, and the final 1920x1080 @ 30fps MP4 exist and are valid.

steps.title: Upload Moving Storybook Video to YouTube (Public)
steps.description:
Upload the generated Moving Storybook MP4 to the Gentle Soul YouTube channel (UCvd4nL04uE7lFqkKtzsOwLg) as a PUBLIC video using ~/.priv/gentle_soul_youtube_token.json via:

python3 /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/src/storybook_pipeline.py --work-dir . --upload

Ensure bilingual JP/EN Storybook title, 0:00 emoji chapter timestamps, and containsSyntheticMedia=True are applied.
